ClinicalTrials.gov API v2: 53,251 studies terminated, suspended or withdrawn, with the line 'why stopped' and their dates; processed 2026-10-22T09:00:04
the counting rule of project 16: a reason names the pandemic if it contains covid, coronavirus, SARS-CoV, 2019-nCoV, pandemic or lockdown
2,642 of 47,429 stated reasons name the pandemic; 31.5 % of reasons in the first half of 2020, about a fifth through 2021, under 3 % from 2024, 30 still in 2025

the register dates a study's end by its last visit and its reason by nothing: 86 reasons naming COVID-19 on studies it ends before 2020 (median 41 months to the entry's last change); 8 name an influenza pandemic
